title: Phase 2.1 — HELIX-HARDEN: Production-harden ServiceFlow SDM platform
spec:
PHASE 2.1: HELIX-HARDEN

Production-harden the Helix / ServiceFlow SDM platform — the flagship project.

LOCATION: platforms/serviceflow-sdm/

This is a READ-FIRST, REPORT-BACK task. Audit the current state before making changes.

TASK 1: BACKEND AUDIT (Express/TypeScript)
  - List all Express routes and whether they have input validation
  - Check JWT auth implementation — is it real or mocked?
  - Check for rate limiting on API endpoints
  - Verify PostgreSQL migration files — do they run cleanly?
  - Check if GET /api/health endpoint exists
  - Report: what works, what's mocked, what's missing

TASK 2: FRONTEND AUDIT (React/Vite)
  - Run: npm install && npm run build (report any errors)
  - List all page/view components and their status (functional/placeholder/broken)
  - Check theme toggle — does it persist across navigation?
  - Check for console errors in component code
  - Report: how many views work vs placeholder

TASK 3: MOBILE AUDIT (React Native/Expo)
  - Check package.json for outdated dependencies
  - List implemented screens vs placeholder
  - Check if Expo config is valid
  - Report: build-readiness assessment

TASK 4: DOCKER AUDIT
  - Review docker-compose.yml — are all services defined?
  - Check Dockerfiles for frontend and backend
  - Verify environment variable handling (no hardcoded secrets)
  - Report: can docker-compose up --build succeed?

TASK 5: DOCS AUDIT
  - Is README current with actual setup instructions?
  - Does docs/REQUIREMENTS.md reflect actual state?
  - Is there a CHANGELOG?
  - Check docs/legacy/ — are the ported files from Phase 1 indexed?

TASK 6: Security check
  - grep for hardcoded credentials in source
  - Verify .env.example exists with placeholder values
  - Check .gitignore coverage
  - Report any findings

REPORT FORMAT:
For each task area, provide:
  - Status: PRODUCTION-READY / NEEDS-WORK / PLACEHOLDER
  - Specific issues found
  - Recommended fixes (prioritized)

CONSTRAINTS:
  - Audit first — do NOT make code changes without reporting findings
  - OK to fix: README gaps, missing .gitignore entries, broken imports
  - NOT OK to fix without approval: route changes, auth changes, schema changes
